name: synapsidian
description: Second brain in an Obsidian vault: daily notes and briefs, tasks, meetings, saving from conversations, ingesting articles, videos and documents, research, thinking tools, search and reviews. Every change is a git commit in the vault. Projects come with the synapsidian-projects add-on, work features with synapsidian-work.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Absolute path of the Obsidian vault the plugin reads and writes, e.g. /Users/you/Synapsidian.

auto_approve_vault_edits.title: Auto-approve vault edits
auto_approve_vault_edits.description: Let Claude write .md/.base/.canvas notes inside the vault without a permission prompt (never About.md, Templates/, CLAUDE.md or .claude/, which always ask). Every change is still a git commit you can revert. Turned off, the scheduled runs stop at the first note edit and wait for you.

session_exclude_paths.title: Folders kept off the record
session_exclude_paths.description: Claude sessions started in these folders (or matching these glob patterns, e.g. ~/Clients/*) never reach the devlog, the evening run or the stand-up. A single session can also opt out by including #off-the-record in a message. Leave empty to log every session.

morning_sources.title: Morning sources
morning_sources.description: Sources the morning run reads, read-only, through a connector in the session. Today: mail (unanswered inbox asks become tasks). Empty reads none.
